mapper.select: SELECT id, status, customer_id, customer_name, amount FROM biz_order WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, status, amount FROM invoice_apply WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id FROM invoice_apply WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status IN ('PENDING','OPENED') LIMIT 1

SELECT id, order_id AS orderId, title, tax_no AS taxNo, amount, status, invoice_no AS invoiceNo, pdf_url AS pdfUrl, created_time AS createdTime, opened_time AS openedTime FROM invoice_apply WHERE customer_name = #{customerName} ORDER BY created_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invoice_apply (id, order_id, order_no, customer_id, customer_name, title, tax_no, amount, status, created_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{customerId}, #{customerName}, #{title}, #{taxNo}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{createdTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE invoice_apply SET status = 'OPENED', invoice_no = #{invoiceNo}, pdf_url = #{pdfUrl}, operator = #{operator}, opened_time = #{openedTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE invoice_apply SET status = 'REJECTED', remark = #{remark}, operator = #{operator}, opened_time = #{openedTime} WHERE id = #{id}
